SUPERVISOR: user live-tested the building work. TWO results for you:

(1) BUG 1 PASSED — user verbatim: 'in the test game space: i now see the texture on the building, and the window resolved to the cutout.' Your prefab stamp fix (skins + window cutout carried to placed pieces) WORKS. COMMIT IT NOW — explicit paths (placed.ts, placed.test.ts, PlayRoute.tsx render path, whatever the fix touched), verify green first, post hash. Resolve its ledger entry.

(2) NEW BUG — RAMPVEL-0608, user verbatim: 'ramp/stairs: good, seems velocity on going up tho is faster than normally running.' Ascending a ramp gives faster-than-run horizontal speed. Likely the ground-projection in your walkable-surface resolver adds speed instead of preserving it — when movement projects onto the incline, horizontal velocity should be conserved/clamped to run speed, not amplified. Print the player speed on flat vs on-ramp-ascent, read it, clamp ramp ascent to normal run speed. Frame-time gate applies. Queue behind the bug-1 commit.

NOTE: bugs 2/3 (ghost buildings on homepage, new buildings not on map) the user just re-confirmed live — that is AUTHBUILD-REMOVE, still authorized. HOLD execution one more beat: pane 5 is finishing its commit batch and AUTHBUILD touches shared files (index.tsx etc) — I give the execute word the moment pane 5's index is clear, to avoid a git race. Re-confirm your AUTHBUILD inventory against current HEAD while you wait so it fires clean.
